column1: # Where each town named in data/era-ground.tsv is, for ONE purpose: tools/build-era.py hands the point to the kit's erasnap.py, which REFUSES a
# place whose point falls inside a DIFFERENT region's ring than the one it was given, or within 15 km of its own region's ring edge, or outside
# its own ring (the Atlas's rings are 4-11 vertex shapes, "approximate by design"). It decides nothing else: the region of a place is the row in
# data/era-ground.tsv. Every point is written by hand to two decimals (the centre of the town or comune, or of the department's capital for a
# string that names a department or one of its sections); a cross-check against the ring, never a boundary. The shared gazetteer cache is not
# used: it resolves bare names to homonyms.
